statement: Organizer/Automation identity and Bluetooth device-observation identity are independent domains and MUST NOT be implicitly merged, reused, promoted, or inferred across namespaces.
forbidden: reuse organizer identifiers as bluetooth identifiers
reuse bluetooth identifiers as organizer identifiers
promote bluetooth address or name to a human/operator identity
inherit Organizer/Automation DEVICE_VALIDATED or PERSISTENT_VALIDATED from Bluetooth validation
inherit Bluetooth validation state from Organizer/Automation worker qualification
correlate the domains solely because values are textually equal

requirements: no human attribution unless independently supported

fail_closed_rule: Any ambiguous or missing cross-domain identity evidence leaves the relationship unbound.
epistemic_boundary: A Bluetooth identifier is evidence about a Bluetooth device observation, not proof of the human operator.
supersession_rule: A later policy may supersede this invariant only by explicitly preserving or narrowing the no-implicit-merge guarantee.
